coverage.not_covered: structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, industrial/facility, spline-heavy and large-coordinate (above 1e6) drawings: I found no drawing in these classes with a licence I could establish, and a drawing whose licence cannot be established does not enter the corpus. The synthetic large-coords-001 and huge-extent-001 cover the large-coordinate arithmetic but are not real-world.

private_pack: none yet: every fixture here is PUBLIC_REDISTRIBUTABLE. A PRIVATE source would appear in fixtures/real-world as its id and hashes only, with the bytes in a pack outside this repository, and runner.corpus.private_path_problems fails the run if a PRIVATE DWG is present.
